input: Rewire the outdoor patio string lights safely

gold.taskTitle: Rewire Outdoor Patio String Lights Safely
gold.taskDescription: Safely rewire an existing outdoor patio string light setup, ensuring proper electrical connections and weather-appropriate installation.

questions.title: Are the lights low-voltage or standard 120V?
questions.description: Understanding the voltage type determines the tools, wire gauge, and safety precautions required for the rewiring job.

questions.title: Why are you rewiring — damage, upgrade, or extension?
questions.description: Knowing the reason clarifies the scope: replacing frayed wire, swapping to a new style, or adding more length to the existing run.

questions.title: How long is the total string light run?
questions.description: The total length affects wire gauge selection, the number of sockets needed, and whether a single circuit can safely handle the load.

questions.title: What power source will the lights connect to?
questions.description: Identifying whether the source is a dedicated outdoor outlet, GFCI outlet, extension cord, or hardwired junction box shapes the entire wiring approach.

questions.title: What is the mounting surface — wood, masonry, or metal?
questions.description: The surface type determines which hooks, anchors, or staples are needed to secure the rewired string safely overhead.

questions.title: What bulb type are you using — LED, incandescent, or other?
questions.description: Bulb type affects total wattage load calculations, socket compatibility, and which wire insulation rating is appropriate for the job.

questions.title: Do you have prior experience with basic electrical wiring?
questions.description: Assessing skill level ensures the plan includes the right level of safety guidance, and flags whether a licensed electrician should be involved.
